WEBB COUNTY, Texas — Omar Hinojosa-Mariscal was booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 22, 2026, at 7:31 AM, facing three counts of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Each count is a second-degree felony under Texas law. Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon generally involves allegations of threatening or causing bodily injury while using or exhibiting a deadly weapon. No bond had been set as of the time of the booking listing.

Further details from the arresting agency were not listed in the public booking record.

All charges are allegations. Hinojosa-Mariscal is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
